pages:
Nobody finds this ledge by walking.
You came through the crack, then?
battle_lost:
Fine, fine. The rock keeps secrets
better than I do.
battle_won:
Back through the crack with you.
Mind your elbows.
after:
Drop off the south ledge to leave.
It only goes one way.

pages:
This seam is mine. I cut ice
blocks for the camp.
battle_lost: You hit harder than the frost.
battle_won:
Ice doesn't argue. You do.
That's your mistake.
after:
There's a slide by the far wall.
Mind the drop at the end.

pages:
Shout in here and the mountain
shouts back. Want to hear it?
battle_won:
The mountain says you lost.
Twice, actually. Echo.
after:
The west ledge drops you down
by the lower trail.

pages:
You found the warden hut.
Most climbers walk right past it.
battle_lost:
You climb the way you fight.
Fast, and not very carefully.
battle_won:
Slow down out there. The trail
will still be here tomorrow.
after:
The ledge drops you onto the
south trail. Sign the log first.

pages: A tiny cairn of three pebbles.

Someone carved a smiling face
on the top one.
A snow figure in a climbing helmet.

Its sign says:
STILL WAITING FOR A ROPE.

Old names cut in the rock.
A whole rope team.

The newest one only says:
WAS HERE FIRST.
The trail log. Last entry, Day 40:

"The view is still great.
The snacks are not."
